title: Skyblock-Kaju
body:
KajuXD Hypixel SkyBlock Mods is a carefully optimized and feature-rich modpack designed to give you the best possible Hypixel SkyBlock experience. Whether you’re a grinder, flipper, dungeon sweat, or casual player, this pack boosts performance, clarity, and quality-of-life without breaking Hypixel rules.

🔥 Key Features

⚡ High FPS & Low Lag – Optimized mods for smooth gameplay

🧭 SkyBlock-Specific Utilities – Dungeon helpers, HUD improvements, and skill tracking

🎯 Accurate Information – Better tooltips, item stats, and cleaner menus

🎮 PvE & Dungeon Friendly – Perfect for Dungeons, Slayers, and Kuudra

🎨 Clean & Custom UI – Minimal, modern, and distraction-free design

🔒 Hypixel-Safe Mods Only – No cheats, no bannable features

🚀 Perfect For

Hypixel SkyBlock players

Dungeon runners & slayer grinders

FPS-hungry low-end PCs

Players who want vanilla-plus SkyBlock

🛠️ Built With Care

Every mod in KajuXD is tested for:

Stability

Compatibility

Hypixel safety

Performance impact

No unnecessary clutter — only mods that actually help.
